title: Pure Cyberdark

allow.Cyber Dragon: Shared Cyber card that Cyberdark needs by name: Cybernetic Horizon wants a second Attribute and Cyberdark Wurm sends a Cyber Dragon monster to summon itself.

summary: Pure Cyberdark Machine and Dragon hybrid strategy featuring Zane Truesdale's dark legacy cards alongside modern support. By equipping Dragon monsters from the GY to low-Level Cyberdark Machines and dumping materials via Cybernetic Horizon, the deck assembles five Cyberdark names for Cyberdarkness Dragon and towers into the unaffected Cyberdark End Dragon.

summary.title: Starters
points: Cyberdark Realm on activation searches any Cyberdark monster from Deck to hand, and grants an additional Normal Summon of a Cyberdark monster each turn.
Cyberdark Cannon discards itself to add any Machine Cyberdark monster from Deck to hand, and sends a monster from Deck to GY when used as an Equip Card.
Cyberdark Claw discards itself to search any Cyberdark Spell or Trap from Deck to hand, and sends a monster from the Extra Deck to the GY when used as an Equip Card.

Cybernetic Horizon sends two Dragon or Machine Cyber monsters (one from hand and one from Deck with different Attributes, utilizing Cyber Dragon) to search a Cyber Dragon/Machine and mill a Cyber Fusion from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Cyberdark Realm + Cyberdark Cannon
steps: Activate Cyberdark Cannon's effect in hand, discarding it to search Cyberdark Chimera from your Deck.
Activate Cyberdark Realm to search Cyberdark Claw from your Deck, then discard Claw to search Cybernetic Horizon.
Use Cyberdark Realm's extra Normal Summon to Normal Summon Cyberdark Chimera, activating its effect to discard a Spell/Trap and search Power Bond while enabling GY fusion materials.
Activate Cybernetic Horizon, sending a DARK Cyberdark and LIGHT Cyber Dragon from hand and Deck to the GY to send Cyber End Dragon from Extra Deck to GY and add Cyberdark Wurm.
Activate Power Bond, banishing Cyberdark Horn, Edge, Keel, Cannon, and Claw from your GY to Fusion Summon Cyberdarkness Dragon with doubled ATK.
Tribute Cyberdarkness Dragon equipped with Cyber End Dragon to Special Summon Cyberdark End Dragon directly from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Cyberdark End Dragon boasts 5000 original ATK, is completely unaffected by your opponent's activated effects, and can attack a number of times each Battle Phase up to the number of cards equipped to it.
Cyberdarkness Dragon equips a Dragon or Machine monster from your GY upon Special Summon, and detaches an equipped card to negate any opponent card or effect activation.
Cyberdark Dragon gains 100 ATK for each monster in your GY and equips a Level 3 or lower Dragon from the GY upon summon.
Cyber End Dragon serves as essential Extra Deck dump fodder for Cybernetic Horizon and named fusion material for Cyberdark End Dragon.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Cyberdark Inferno protects equipped Cyberdark monsters from being targeted or destroyed by opponent card effects, and allows you to bounce an equipped Cyberdark to immediately Normal Summon another.
Cyberdark Invasion is a Continuous Trap that equips a Dragon or Machine from either GY to a Cyberdark monster, or sends an equipped card to the GY to destroy an opponent's card.
Cyberdark Impact! shuffles Cyberdark Horn, Edge, and Keel from field, GY, or banishment back into the Deck to Fusion Summon Cyberdark Dragon.
Power Bond fuses Machine bosses while doubling their ATK, turning Cyberdarkness Dragon into an 8000 ATK threat.
